headlines.title_original: Israel election results: Netanyahu bloc drops to 54 seats as Arab parties rise to 18
headlines.summary_original: With 65% of polling stations reporting, Likud leads with 27 seats and Eisenkot's Yashar! holds 21; Netanyahu's bloc stands at 54, Eisenkot's at 48 and Arab parties at 18; Yair Golan calls for a government backed by Arab parties as smaller factions fight to cross the electoral threshold

headlines.title_original: ‘Netanyahu has lost’: Yair Golan calls for coalition with Arab parties
headlines.summary_original: With 60% of votes counted and neither bloc holding a majority, Democrats leader urges opposition to join forces with Ra'am and the Joint List, arguing that Arab votes must count equally and that forming a government of change is a national security imperative

headlines.title_original: IDF kills Hamas commandos involved in Alexander Dancyg's October 7 kidnapping
headlines.summary_original: Ahmed Muhammad Ahmed Baraka, who the IDF says took part in Alexander Dancyg's kidnapping at Kibbutz Nir Oz and later helped hold Nimrod Cohen hostage, was killed in southern Gaza; two other Nukhba operatives were killed Friday in northern Gaza

headlines.title_original: Knife-wielding attacker shot dead outside Israeli Embassy in Belgrade
headlines.summary_original: Serbian interior minister says unidentified minor shouted ‘Allahu Akbar’ and attacked police guard with two knives shortly after midnight; wounded officer shot assailant dead as authorities raised the terror threat level to its highest setting

headlines.title_original: Up to 650,000 special ballots could still turn Israel's election on its head
headlines.summary_original: Representing roughly 15 Knesset seats' worth of votes, the double-envelope ballots come from soldiers, reservists and displaced Israelis; previous elections show they can boost Zionist parties at the expense of ultra-Orthodox and Arab factions

headlines.title_original: Trump claims credit for Netanyahu's election gains as vote count continues
headlines.summary_original: US president says his endorsement helped PM outperform expectations as his right-wing bloc strengthens its position in preliminary results; with counting still underway, neither major political camp has secured a parliamentary majority

headlines.title_original: Netanyahu bloc slips to 55 seats with nearly half the vote counted
headlines.summary_original: With 48.43% counted, Likud leads with 27 seats and Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar has 22; the rival bloc holds 50 seats and Arab parties 15, leaving neither camp with a majority as late-counted military and other ballots could change the balance

headlines.title_original: Smotrich vows Jewish settlements in Gaza as party defies election polls

headlines.title_original: Election results give investors rude reality check
